red.cause: Validated private usage received before account ACK was discarded on phase rejection

behavior: A fully decoded current worker packet rejected before live publication stays once in the existing closing pending slot
Rejected packet never enters live delivery or creates account/image authorization
Per-loop reset prevents stale reuse; existing pending envelope avoids duplicates on publication cancellation; eighteen-packet bound is unchanged
limitations: Focused regression uses actual private socket/channel and lexical test identity, no native peer, CLI, account or billing authority
Cancellation before worker loop obtains a decoded packet is outside this focused regression
Durable consumer must retain evidence while keeping protocol failure/unknown semantics; storage integration remains separate
Initial fixture binding error retained separately and excluded from product RED evidence
